title: Environment and comparison — in sentences
summary: Use the English meaning as well as the Swedish context to choose or type the missing word or phrase. Compare adjectives with -are/-ast or irregular forms; use än for than. Purpose can be expressed with för att + infinitive.

s01.sentenceGloss: It costs less; it is cheaper.

s02.sentenceGloss: The train is faster than the bicycle.

s03.sentenceGloss: This is going well, but that is going even better.

s04.sentenceGloss: We turn off the lights in order to save electricity.

s05.sentenceGloss: Turn off the tap to save water.

s06.sentenceGloss: The bottle is not made of plastic but of glass.

s07.sentenceGloss: We buy second-hand things at a flea market.

s08.sentenceGloss: We sort the waste before it is recycled.
s08.note: Sorterar is the present of sortera.
